notes: One-electron SI couplings are Slater–Condon elements over the Fock matrices of the microstates, the bra/ket mean for an excitation (§si-hamiltonian); SSR energies and state properties follow from them.
SI gradients and NAC are analytic with meta-GGA functionals (§state-gradient, §nac); Laplacian-dependent meta-GGAs are rejected with an input error.
NTO holes, NDOs, state natural orbitals and EKT eigenvectors are in a canonical basis of each degenerate span (§nto, §natural-orbitals).
